The '''Star Fortress''' over [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] was a [[Star Fortress]] deployed by [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Arcann]] of the [[Eternal Empire]] to watch for possible uprisings on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. It was commanded by [[Exarch]] [[Malforia]], known for her ruthless ferocity and the fixation on [[Tyth]], one of the [[Zakuul]]an [[Six Gods|Old Gods]]. However, [[IR-9X Replicator Droid|replicator droids]] of [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]] destroyed the Star Fortress and took Malforia prisoner to study her fanaticism.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Balmorran Star Fortress is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' in the codex entry obtained during '''Interlude: Shroud of Memory'''.<ref name="SWTOR" />
